purpose: Predeclare deterministic, leakage-resistant forms for combining independently frozen candidate outputs.

composition_forms.name: SIGN_CONSENSUS_STATE
composition_forms.rule: fixed sign-count and dispersion over compatible component families

composition_forms.name: EQUAL_WEIGHT_FAMILY_SCORE
composition_forms.rule: equal ex-ante family weights; no fitted weights

composition_forms.name: CROSS_SECTIONAL_RANK_CONSENSUS
composition_forms.rule: combine already-predeclared cross-sectional ranks with a fixed aggregation rule

composition_forms.name: RELIABILITY_OVERLAY
composition_forms.rule: apply Q104:R9-style descriptive consensus/reliability state to an already frozen bundle

composition_forms.name: ABSTENTION_NO_CONSENSUS
composition_forms.rule: emit explicit neutral/abstain state when fixed agreement conditions are not met
